summary: This bill extends increased dependency and indemnity compensation to surviving spouses of veterans who die from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), regardless of how long the veteran had the disease, and requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to report on other service-connected disabilities that should receive similar treatment.
